$comment: Single source of truth for the semantic intent vocabulary. Edit here only. `canonical` lists every valid intent and the color token it maps to (null = the component's own default styling, no dedicated color token). `surface` (optional) declares how indicator-style components paint the intent: `true` derives base=`--wim-color-<color>`, on=`--wim-color-text-on-<color>` and text=`--wim-color-text-<color>`; an object names the base/on/text color tokens explicitly (for intents whose surface differs from their color token, e.g. neutral). `text` is the WCAG AA readable foreground used by outline/subtle variants — the base fill color is NOT contrast-safe as text (e.g. warning #ff7f00 is ~2.5:1 on white). `subtle` (optional) names the background token for the subtle variant verbatim; without it the variant derives `base` at 15% alpha, which disappears for intents whose base is already a near-surface tint (neutral = disabled #e5e5e5 at 15% is invisible on white). Intents without `surface` produce no generated indicator classes (they fall back to the component's own default styling). `sets` declares the intent subset each component family exposes; every member MUST appear in `canonical`. Run `npm run intents:build` (also part of `npm run tokens:build`) to regenerate src/types/generated-intents.ts and src/tokens/generated/_intents.scss. `npm run check:intents` fails if either committed output is stale.

WimIntent.description: Unified semantic intent values for components.

ButtonIntent.description: Semantic intent values available on Button. A deliberate subset of WimIntent — buttons express danger/success/neutral, not the full palette of feedback intents.

IndicatorIntent.description: Intent values for indicator-style components (Badge, Chip, Tag, Progress).

FeedbackIntent.description: Intent values for feedback-style components (Alert, Banner, Toast, Notification, Snackbar). Includes neutral default — colored intents are opt-in.

FieldIntent.description: Intent values for form field components (Input, Textarea, DatePicker, RichTextEditor).
